page.overview:
Who is Aquatic Soldiers?

Aquatic Soldiers belongs to Journey to the West. The Aquatic Soldiers(水族士兵, Shuizu Shibing) are collectively referred to as the troops affiliated with the Dragon Palaces.

They are armies composed of various marine creatures, responsible for defending the Dragon Palaces and going out to fight when necessary.

In Journey to the West, Aquatic Soldiers sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
